Improved Heroic Strike.text: Reduces the cost of your Heroic Strike ability by 1 rage point.

Improved Rend.text: Increases the bleed damage done by your Rend ability by 15%.

Improved Charge.text: Increases the amount of rage generated by your Charge ability by 3.

Tactical Mastery.text: You retain up to 5 of your rage points when you change stances.

Improved Thunder Clap.text: Reduces the cost of your Thunder Clap ability by 1 rage point.

Improved Overpower.text: Increases the critical strike chance of your Overpower ability by 25%.

Anger Management.text: Increases the time required for your rage to decay while out of combat by 30%.

Deep Wounds.text: Your critical strikes cause the opponent to bleed, dealing 20% of your melee weapon's average damage over 12 sec.

Two-Handed Weapon Specialization.text: Increases the damage you deal with two-handed melee weapons by 1%.

Impale.text: Increases the critical strike damage bonus of your abilities in Battle, Defensive, and Berserker stance by 10%.

Axe Specialization.text: Increases your chance to get a critical strike with Axes by 1%.

Sweeping Strikes.text: Your next 5 melee attacks strike an additional nearby opponent.

Mace Specialization.text: Gives you a 1% chance to stun your target for 3 sec with a Mace.

Sword Specialization.text: Gives you a 1% chance to get an extra attack on the same target after dealing damage with your Sword.

Polearm Specialization.text: Increases your chance to get a critical strike with Polearms by 1%.

Improved Hamstring.text: Gives your Hamstring ability a 5% chance to immobilize the target for 5 sec.

Mortal Strike.text: A vicious strike that deals weapon damage plus 85 and wounds the target, reducing the effectiveness of any healing by 50% for 10 sec.

Booming Voice.text: Increases the area of effect and duration of your Battle Shout and Demoralizing Shout by 10%.

Cruelty.text: Increases your chance to get a critical strike with melee weapons by 1%.

Improved Demoralizing Shout.text: Increases the melee attack power reduction of your Demoralizing Shout by 8%.

Unbridled Wrath.text: Gives you a 8% chance to generate an additional Rage point when you deal melee damage with a weapon.

Improved Cleave.text: Increases the bonus damage done by your Cleave ability by 40%.

Piercing Howl.text: Causes all enemies near the warrior to be dazed, reducing movement speed by 50% for 6 sec.

Blood Craze.text: Regenerates 1% of your total Health over 6 sec after being the victim of a critical strike.

Improved Battle Shout.text: Increases the melee attack power bonus of your Battle Shout by 5%.

Dual Wield Specialization.text: Increases the damage done by your offhand weapon by 5%.

Improved Execute.text: Reduces the Rage cost of your Execute ability by 2.

Enrage.text: Gives you a 5% melee damage bonus for 12 sec up to a maximum of 12 swings after being the victim of a critical strike.

Improved Slam.text: Decreases the casting time of your Slam ability by 0.1 sec.

Death Wish.text: When activated, increases your physical damage by 20% and makes you immune to Fear effects, but lowers your armor and all resistances by 20%. Lasts 30 sec.

Improved Intercept.text: Reduces the cooldown of your Intercept ability by 5 sec.

Improved Berserker Rage.text: The Berserker Rage ability will generate 5 rage when used.

Flurry.text: Increases your attack speed by 10% for your next 3 swings after dealing a melee critical strike.

Bloodthirst.text: Instantly attack the target causing damage equal to 45% of your attack power. In addition, the next 5 successful melee attacks will restore 10 health. This effect lasts 8 sec.

Shield Specialization.text: Increases your chance to block attacks with a shield by 1% and has a 20% chance to generate 1 rage when a block occurs.

Improved Bloodrage.text: Increases the instant Rage generated by your Bloodrage ability by 2.

Toughness.text: Increases your armor value from items by 2%.

Iron Will.text: Increases your chance to resist Stun and Charm effects by an additional 3%.

Last Stand.text: When activated, this ability temporarily grants you 30% of your maximum hit points for 20 seconds. After the effect expires, the hit points are lost.

Improved Shield Block.text: Allows your Shield Block ability to block an additional attack and increases the duration by 0.5 second.

Improved Revenge.text: Gives your Revenge ability a 15% chance to stun the target for 3 sec.

Defiance.text: Increases the threat generated by your attacks by 3% while in Defensive Stance.

Improved Sunder Armor.text: Reduces the cost of your Sunder Armor ability by 1 rage point.

Improved Disarm.text: Increases the duration of your Disarm ability by 1 secs.

Improved Taunt.text: Reduces the cooldown of your Taunt ability by 1 sec.

Improved Shield Wall.text: Increases the effect duration of your Shield Wall ability by 3 secs.

Improved Shield Bash.text: Gives your Shield Bash ability a 50% chance to silence the target for 3 sec.

One-Handed Weapon Specialization.text: Increases the damage you deal with One-Handed Melee weapons by 2%.

Shield Slam.text: Slam the target with your shield, causing 225 to 235 damage, modified by your shield block value, and has a 50% chance of dispelling 1 magic effect on the target. Also causes a high amount of threat.
